summary: The customer called back very upset after a previous agent allegedly shouted at him, explaining that he is hard of hearing and confused. The agent apologized, spoke clearly and calmly, and addressed the customer's issue regarding his internet being cut off despite paying yesterday. The agent asked for the phone number, repeated it back correctly, and stated he would check the payment status.

evidence.speaker: Agent

commitments.description: The agent promised to check the payment status immediately and report back.

evidence.text: تمام، فهمت عليك، رح أشيك على نظام الدفعات الآن وأرجع أرد عليك بالتفصيل، ممكن تعطيني رقم الخط لو سمحت؟

compliance_flags.description: The agent asked for account details and proceeded without performing full customer identity verification.

rubric_scores.justification: The agent maintained professional composure and apologized sincerely for the customer's prior negative experience.
